=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:6737-6764 | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `mark_validation_complete` appends validation history with an uninitialized `validation_cycle`, so the recorded cycle can be missing/null.
  WHY: Two reviewers flagged the same call path; an empty cycle would be serialized as null and can distort cycle-based ordering/history correlation.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~4650-4720 | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `validation_history_gate_decision_for_current_sha` treats later non-harness failures with missing/null `raw_status` as neutral, letting promotion proceed.
  WHY: The `raw_status_text != "" && raw_status_text != "harness_error"` predicate only excludes populated strings, so older or malformed failure records can bypass the intended rerun-before-promote behavior.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~4740-4790 | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `check_integration_branch_staleness` can emit duplicate stale alerts because the alert state update is not guarded against overlapping polls.
  WHY: The report says the check runs every poll and the state write is not atomic across runs, so concurrent or re-dispatched executions can observe stale pre-write state.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:~164-170, ~186-192 | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Fail-open responses from `memory_validation_history_get`/`append` do not consistently populate durable sentinels when `ai_memory.py` returns malformed or empty output.
  WHY: The report says the gate relies on current-tick globals, so a transient read/write failure can be lost on the next poll and misclassified.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~4566-4590, ~6746-6764 | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `append_validation_history_for_current_sha` records write failure only in in-memory globals and does not persist a last-failed-append marker.
  WHY: The report says the gate only checks the current-tick sentinel, so the failure signal can disappear across polls and allow an unvalidated promotion path.
- README.md:~125-132, ~976-983, ~1470-1477 | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The new env-var documentation for `ORCH_INTEGRATION_STALE_ALERT_HOURS` / `REALERT_HOURS` is duplicated with slightly different wording across README sections.
  WHY: The reviewer called out three divergent README spots, creating inconsistent operator docs even though runtime behavior is unchanged.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- requirement: Persist each validation outcome against the current integration SHA, and require a real passing validation record for the current SHA before ready-to-merge promotion while ignoring harness-only entries.
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (finalize_integration_merge_if_needed + validation_history_gate_decision_for_current_sha) + tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]

The gate is defensive but does not make the history record authoritative except on explicit memory errors (as required). No diff hunk fully eliminates the legacy path.

  WHY: The `raw_status_text != "" && raw_status_text != "harness_error"` predicate and ordering logic only catch populated strings, and the issue reports that real memory records can have `null`.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~6740 and ~6737-6744 / ~6746-6764 | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: `validation_cycle` is referenced in `mark_validation_complete` without being bound locally or read from state, so the appended history entry can get the wrong `cycle` value.
  WHY: The function declares only `local validation_history_raw_status` and `validation_history_conclusion`; without a cycle binding the history entry can become `null` or default incorrectly and affect latest-pass selection.

  WHY: The report says the check runs unconditionally on every poll and concurrent or re-dispatched runs can both observe the pre-write state.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh:~164-170 and ~186-192 | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: Empty, malformed, or nonzero-exit `ai_memory.py` results are not handled consistently, so fail-open sentinels are not reliably populated.
  WHY: The report says the caller can fall through to `history_read_invalid` / `history_write_failed_current_tick` without consistent sentinel state, and the next tick can misclassify the failure.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~4566-4590, ~6746+ | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: On memory append failure the function only sets globals and does not write a durable “last failed append for this SHA” marker.
  WHY: The gate only checks the current-tick sentinel, so the failure signal can be lost on the next poll and the history can be treated as clean.
